description:
[Servers] Rust server networks (brands) and their player counts. Networks running two or more Rust servers - the list on servers.rustprofit.com/brands. Servers are grouped
when they publish the same website, Discord invite, logo or connect address in their A2S server rules, so a
network's new servers join on their own. Each brand: `slug`, `name`, `domain`, `website_url`, `discord_url`,
`socials`, `logo_url`, `servers` (in the network), `online` (servers online now), `players` (online now) and its
page `url`. Recomputed every 10 minutes; use `/servers/brands/{slug}` for the member servers. Server networks (e.g. Rustoria, Rusticated): servers grouped by the website/Discord/logo they publish.

min_online.description: Only networks with at least this many servers online now (the site's /brands page uses 1).

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the network's name or domain.

sort.description: `players` online now (default, the site's order), `servers` in the network, or `name`.

name: list_server_brands
title: Rust server networks (brands) and their player counts
